subject: BrightBridge estimate — quick recap and next-step offer
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightbridge.io>, BrightBridge Sales Ops <salesops@brightbridge.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBridge estimate + short recap (attached)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. I enjoyed learning more about the inference patterns you described (higher QPS for 1–2s responses, bursty nightly jobs for batch reranks). Attaching the estimate we discussed and a short recap below so it’s easy to share with your team.

Recap (TL;DR)
- Recommended initial configuration: 2x dedicated pods (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) for low-latency online; 1x batch node pool for nightly reranks.
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~12k tokens/min under your load profile.
- Cost guidance in attached estimate (line items for Dedicated, Hosted fallback, SRE support).

Next steps
- I can walk your engineering lead through the estimate and the autoscaling profile in a 30-min call — helpful to validate the batch window and KV cache sizing.
- Please confirm priority/timing so we can hold Marcus (solutions engineer) for a technical walkthrough.

Proposed slots (PST): Wed 7/11 10:00–10:30, Thu 7/12 14:00–14:30, Tue 7/16 09:00–09:30. If none of these work, tell me what’s best and I’ll adapt.

Attachment: BrightBridge_Redwood_Estimate_v1.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — just checking in quickly since I hadn’t seen confirmation for the 7/16 slot. I know timing can shift — curious if this is still a priority for BrightBridge right now, or if you’d like us to pause and revisit later.

If it helps, Marcus can join for a focused 20–30 minute technical walk-through to validate the autoscaling and cache assumptions (no sales deck, purely technical review). He’s available Tue 7/16 09:00 PST and Wed 7/17 11:00 PST.

If you’re not the right owner for scheduling, feel free to loop in whoever is running infra procurement. I’ve included BrightBridge Sales Ops in the original thread for easy handoff.

Quick ask — would you say this is: 
- 1) High priority (we should schedule now),
- 2) Medium (reviewing, will confirm next week), or
- 3) Low (we can pause and I’ll follow up in 4 weeks).

Reply with 1 / 2 / 3 and I’ll take it from there — or pick a slot and I’ll send calendar invite with Marcus attached.

Thanks,
Hannah
